description: Open-source AI voiceover & podcast narration studio — production-ready Next.js SaaS with fine-grained voice controls (speed, pitch, volume) powered by MiniMax Speech 2.6. Free ElevenLabs & Murf AI alternative with Stripe billing, credits, NextAuth, and Prisma.
